info.title: AI Dash Export API
info.description: Read-only API for ChatGPT GPTs to access course R&D project data, AI call logs, baselines, and prompt templates.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, framework_confirmed, finalized, published

get.summary: Get full project detail with generation config snapshot, framework, lesson drafts, and validation results

200.description: Full project detail including generationConfigSnapshot with dimensions, baselineVersions, promptTemplateVersions, and actionConfigs

get.summary: Get the complete AI call chain for a project, including full system prompts, user messages, and prompt template identifiers

200.description: Paginated AI call logs with sequence numbers, action labels, lesson numbers, promptTemplateId, promptTemplateActionKey, and promptTemplateVersionNo

get.summary: Get all baseline documents (23 docs across 6 dimensions: general, age A1-A4, level L1-L4, org_form S1-S2, deliverable P1-P11, matrix) with current version numbers

200.description: All baseline documents with type, key, label, content, currentVersionNo

get.summary: Get all prompt templates (9 action templates) with current version numbers and extracted variable lists

200.description: All prompt templates with actionKey, content, currentVersionNo, and variables array (name, group, description for each {{variable}} used)
